moves.name: TreVeyon Henderson
moves.text: Hold TreVeyon Henderson (NE RB) - RotoWire: "Out multiple weeks" (Oct 13); out Weeks 6-7, back about Week 8; ~10.7 a game when healthy. Once back he is worth ~12 pts to the best lineup through Week 17, more than the cheapest other bench seat, Kaelon Black (SF RB, ~5 pts). If a roster seat is needed while he is out, free that one instead. Dom's call - never an order.
